The LSM6DSOX offers five different operating modes for the accelerometer, which can be categorized into power-saving and high-performance modes:

1. Power-down mode
2. Ultralow-power (ULP) mode (see [3])
3. Low-power mode (available for lower ODRs: 1.6, 12.5, 26, 52 Hz)
4. Normal mode (available for ODRs equal to 104 and 208 Hz)
5. High-performance mode (valid for all ODRs from 12.5 Hz up to 6.66 kHz)

For the gyroscope, the LSM6DSOX offers four different operating modes:

1. Power-down mode
2. Low-power mode (available for lower ODRs: 12.5, 26, 52 Hz)
3. Normal mode (available for ODRs equal to 104 and 208 Hz)
4. High-performance mode (valid for all ODRs from 12.5 Hz up to 6.66 kHz)

Note that the operating modes are selected based on the values of the XL_HM_MODE bit in CTRL6_C (15h) for the accelerometer and G_HM_MODE bit in CTRL7_G (16h) for the gyroscope.
